name: tyrannosaurus
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Project asset: transparent 2D animation atlas for the child's Bluey-style Dinosaur World game. Aspect ratio exactly 2:1. Four equal square columns and two equal square rows. Eight separate full body poses of the SAME friendly dinosaur, all facing RIGHT. Flat solid cartoon colors, simple clean dark outlines, cheerful shapes, no gradients, no photorealism or 3D, no text, labels, grid, background, riders or shadow blobs. Genuine transparent background. Keep the complete dinosaur including head and tail inside the central 70% of each cell with generous clear gutters. Fixed torso scale and registration in all cells. Four movement cycle phases on the top row; bottom row relaxed standing, looking around, friendly calling with open mouth, resting alert. A small soft turquoise riding cushion is integrated on the middle of its back and MUST stay at the identical position relative to its torso across all eight frames. No bridle, straps over head, weapons, frightened expressions, or extra props. Foot baseline around 85% down each square. The cushion should be clearly visible and level, so a separate cartoon child can sit on it. Species: Friendly orange T. rex with big head, two strong hind legs, two small forearms, full counterbalancing tail. A modest back cushion just above the hips. Compact height so the full body and cushion are clear.

name: valley
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Wide 3:1 landscape scenic panel for a child's flat 2D Bluey-style Dinosaur World game. A peaceful prehistoric valley, soft fern groves and round conifer silhouettes, pale blue distant mountains, a small distant waterfall, pastel warm rocks, blue sky and friendly clouds. Very simple flat solid color shapes and clean edges, minimal texture, no gradients, no realistic painting or 3D. Foreground lower 40% is a broad level clear sandy walking/riding meadow, no obstacles or water there, with sparse tiny grass tufts. The middle has four softly colored resting clearings. Horizon and scenery stay high so cartoon dinosaurs and riders can be added as separate game objects. NO animals, dinosaurs, people, fences, saddles, usable props, buildings, text, signs or watermark. Clear open space on both far edges for connected panoramic scrolling.
